orbs.descriptor: An Orb is your personal or shared capsule to plan, dream, and look back.
orbs.frozenNotice: This is a copy from when you left — you can look, not change
orbs.deleteSoloConfirm: Delete this Orb? You’ll keep a frozen copy so nothing here is lost.
orbs.leaveSharedConfirm: They keep the live Orb. You get a frozen copy of what’s already here.
orbs.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? They get a copy of what was already here. This Orb stays live for everyone else.
orbs.pastOrbsSub: Orbs you’ve left or set aside
orbs.viewingFrozenBanner: Viewing a past Orb — you can look back, but plans are frozen
orbs.deletePermanentConfirm: Permanently delete this Orb? All past plans here will be purged forever.

plans.emptyFrozen: A copy from when you left

ideas.emptyShared: Things you want to do together, before they have a day
ideas.emptyFrozen: A copy of this list from when you left
ideas.addOptionNote: Something you want to do, with no date yet.
